_comment_top: Parameter template for the first supervised low-speed HIL ground diagnostic (a bounded, exclusionary diagnostic test, NOT a formal navigation trial and NOT the formal shared-exit experiment). Deliberately a SEPARATE file from hil_frozen_params.json: it never modifies that file's formal frozen evidence, and it scopes only the small geometry set this one straight-line diagnostic actually needs (start pose, travel direction, a stop line, and boundary clearance), not the full shared-exit arena/exit/parking/search-waypoint geometry. Any field whose value is not yet backed by a real measurement is the literal string 'UNCONFIRMED_PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT'. This file holds only TRACKED configuration -- measured geometry and stable venue facts -- checked via hil_preflight.check_required_fields_ready() against required_before_ground_motion below. Per-session runtime confirmations (operator present, Wi-Fi checked) are NOT in this file; they live in a separate, gitignored session-state file managed by hil_ground_diagnostic_session.py, checked independently every run. run_ground_diagnostic_preflight.sh runs two explicit phases -- pre-stack and live-zero-state -- combining this file's tracked-field check with the session-state check and, in the live-zero-state phase only, live ROS-graph/evidence facts that cannot exist before the physical stack is started.

reused_frozen_reference._comment: Read-only references to already-confirmed values recorded elsewhere. Never duplicated as separately-editable numbers here, and never re-derived or re-measured -- copied for traceability only.
reused_frozen_reference.guard_hard_linear_cap_source: hil_frozen_params.json hil_guard_limits.max_linear_speed_mps (confirmed, unchanged by this diagnostic)
reused_frozen_reference.suspended_wheel_angular_value_excluded_n: angular_suspension_diagnostic_20260723/SUMMARY.md's temporary +-0.1 rad/s value is explicitly NOT reused here or anywhere in this diagnostic -- ground angular motion is prohibited for this first test (see diagnostic_command_limits.angular_speed_prohibited below), and that suspended-wheel value has never been and must never be written into hil_frozen_params.json's max_angular_speed_rps as a ground limit.

diagnostic_command_limits._comment: Reuses hil_wheel_suspension_test.py exactly as already built and tested for the suspended-wheel diagnostic -- no new pulse-generation mechanism. angular is not a tunable field here: it is fixed at 0.0 and prohibited, enforced independently by both this file and hil_cmd_vel_guard.py's own --max-angular-speed-rps 0.0 CLI argument at runbook execution time.

measured_geometry._comment: The minimum geometry this straight-line diagnostic needs -- deliberately smaller than hil_frozen_params.json's field_geometry (no exit/parking/search-waypoint fields; this test never approaches or searches for an exit). All UNCONFIRMED until the field-measurement form is completed. No minimum dimension or threshold is asserted anywhere in this file -- these are recorded measurements only, never compared against an invented number.

environment._comment: Boolean confirmation fields for STABLE facts about the fixed test venue -- floor condition, the travel path, and recorded obstacle/boundary locations do not vary session to session the way operator presence or Wi-Fi do, so they are tracked and committed here, not in the per-session state file (see hil_ground_diagnostic_session.py). Default false; never silently treated as true.

safety._comment: emergency_stop_position_confirmed records a stable fact about the fixed venue (where the e-stop/operator position is relative to the test area), so it stays tracked here. operator_present_confirmed is NOT here -- a person's presence is true only for the current session and must never be committed as a permanent fact; it lives in the gitignored session-state file (hil_ground_diagnostic_session.py) and defaults false every session. Distinct from and in addition to the verbal, per-session USER_AT_EMERGENCY_STOP=YES/TEST_AREA_CLEAR=YES confirmations already required elsewhere.

_comment_required_before_ground_motion: This list covers only TRACKED configuration -- stable venue facts and measured geometry. It intentionally excludes operator_present_confirmed and wifi_checked_in_test_area: those are per-session runtime confirmations checked separately, every run, via hil_ground_diagnostic_session.py's gitignored session-state file, never via this tracked file.
